name: Morgan ``indrora'' Gangwere
biography: Morgan is a student at the University of New Mexico where he studies an unrelated topic entirely, but does network security because it's interesting. Previously, he's spoken on subjects such as web proxies, community engagement, and typesetting. He started working with computers when he was a young child and hasn't given them up since, even if his wrists seem to disagree.
